_comment: omni-queue ruleset template for ONE release branch (docs/ops/OMNI_QUEUE.md). Applied by scripts/merge-queue/apply-ruleset.mjs, which replaces {{base}}, suffixes the name with the branch and sets the App bypass actor_id from --app-id. Keys starting with '_' are stripped before the REST call. No required-checks rule on purpose: the queue validates the candidate, not the PR.
name: omni-queue release protection
